$comment: Every cam here is a 24/7 YouTube livestream. The four Atlantic cams (plus jax-beach-bw-cam, added 2026-10-17, which faces east-north-east at 70 degrees) face EAST; the two Gulf cams (Fort Myers Beach, Pensacola Beach, added 2026-10-15, see docs/research/2026-10-15-west-facing-cams.md) face WEST. `facing` is 'east' or 'west' (derived from facing_azimuth_deg when absent: below 180 = east, else west). An east cam sees a sunrise as a 'solar' view and a sunset as 'antisolar'; a west cam is the reverse. Only a 'solar' view is the truth for an event's color; an 'antisolar' view is the afterglow behind the cam, stored but never used as truth.

sky_regions are [x0, y0, x1, y1] as fractions of the frame (0,0 = top-left). They keep the sky and drop the flagpole, palms, pier, beach, water and the burned-in text overlays. They were drawn from real 1280x720 frames (Elbo: the 2026-10-06 sunrise frames; Deerfield: live frames pulled from the uw-frame worker on 2026-10-06).

beaches[].lat/lon repeat config/locations.ts; distance_mi is the great-circle distance from that beach's pin to the cam, rounded to 0.1 mi. lib/sunCamsConfig.test.ts keeps both in lockstep with locations.ts.
credit is stored with every observation and the ingest route rejects any other string. Elbo Room gave the owner permission to use its stream as long as it is credited.

cams.name: Deerfield Beach Cam
cams.credit: Live stream courtesy City of Deerfield Beach

cams.name: Deerfield Beach - Surf Cam
cams.note: A PTZ camera: it pans between presets, and the horizon sits anywhere from y=0.27 to y=0.46. The sky region is therefore only the top slice that is sky in every pose.
cams.credit: Live stream courtesy City of Deerfield Beach

cams.name: Deerfield Beach - Fishing Pier Cam
cams.credit: Live stream courtesy City of Deerfield Beach

cams.name: Fort Myers Beach Cam (Visit Fort Myers)
cams.note: A fixed camera on the Times Square block looking south-west over the beach and the Gulf, with a beach-building site in the foreground. The sun sets just beyond the right edge in October (the frame sees the sky and the afterglow) and inside the frame near the winter solstice. Visitors can pan it from visitfortmyers.com, so the regions are for the usual pose.
cams.credit: Live stream courtesy Visit Fort Myers (Lee County Visitor & Convention Bureau)

cams.name: Pensacola Beach - West Cam (Santa Rosa Island Authority)
cams.note: A fisheye camera on Casino Beach looking west along the sand: the Gulf is on the left, the beach and a low skyline on the right. The sky is a thin strip along the top and the horizon curves, so the regions follow it.
cams.credit: Live stream courtesy Santa Rosa Island Authority

cams.name: Jacksonville Beach Cam (Best Western Oceanfront Jacksonville Beach)
cams.note: A fixed camera at the Best Western oceanfront looking east-north-east over the beach and the sea. The sky is only a thin strip (about 8% of the frame) above a sharp horizon, and the burned-in date sits across its left third, so the region starts to the right of it.
cams.credit: Live stream courtesy Best Western Oceanfront Jacksonville Beach and 911 Surf Report
